When this happens, eye movement inevitably becomes less active and the reaction to stimuli becomes duller. As this phenomenon intensifies, the responses of muscles and brain waves also decline, gradually reaching a drowsy state. Driving in such a state of reduced alertness is called so-called 'reduced-alertness driving.'

590: Driving at an economical speed is the driving method that most improves fuel efficiency.
